title: Radius-doubling 2delta in the interleaved MCA collapse pushes the only unconditional (MDS-incidence) list bound out of the prize window: non-vacuity needs delta <= (1-rho)/2, which is AT OR BELOW the Johnson edge 1-sqrt(rho); inside the window the bound is literally vacuous (0 <= C(n,k)).
reduced_to: An honest unconditional MCA bound via the interleaved collapse REQUIRES a sub-C(n,k)/C(2t-n,k) (higher-order / GM-MDS) list-decoding bound for C^{=2} at the DOUBLED (half-)radius a=2t-n=(1-2delta)n. The crude MDS-incidence charging |interleavedList(a)|*C(a,k) <= C(n,k) is non-vacuous ONLY for a >= k, i.e. delta <= (1-rho)/2; since (1-rho)/2 <= 1-sqrt(rho)=Johnson edge for all rho<1 (equality iff rho=1), this is at-or-below the BOTTOM of the open window, so the unconditional route is vacuous everywhere in (1-sqrt(rho),1-rho). The clean open statement it sharpens to: produce a list bound L(C^{=2}, a) << C(n,k)/C(a,k) (sub-exponential, ideally poly(q)) at a=(1-2delta)n for delta interior -- exactly the open higher-order-MDS / GM-MDS certificate, which is the prize core.
wall: W-subspace (the open higher-order-MDS / GM-MDS interior list bound for C^{=2}); welds further to W-Johnson (the non-vacuity threshold (1-rho)/2 sits exactly at-or-below the Johnson edge, so the only unconditional handle dies precisely where the open window begins). The 'B4 circular -- needs Lambda(C)<=O(1)' verdict is the Lambda_interleaved_sandwich/deltaStar_collapse_backward statement that the interleaved view can never beat the single-code list at radius delta.
evidence: Exact-integer + lgamma-log2 probe scripts/probes/_407_conn/C049_window_vacuity.py (output scripts/probes/_407_conn/_C049_out.txt). PART 1 (re-verifies the in-tree exhaustive counterexample for same-radius falsity, exact enumeration over F3): C=span{(1,1,1,0),(0,1,2,1)}, f1=(0,0,0,1), f2=(0,0,1,0), t=3 -> #mcaBad=3 (all scalars 0,1,2 bad), interleavedList@floor t = 0 pairs, so same-radius RHS 1+(n-t)*0 = 1 < 3: the no-doubling collapse is FALSE; the proven doubled-radius theorem a=2t-n=2 gives interleavedList@a=6 pairs, RHS=13 >= 3 holds. This matches InterleavedListMCACollapse.lean's mcaBad_card_le_interleavedList (proven, axiom-clean) and its docstring counterexample exactly. PART 2 (the non-vacuity arithmetic): a=2t-n>=k  <=> 1-2delta>=rho <=> delta<=(1-rho)/2 (EXACT); and (1-rho)/2 <= 1-sqrt(rho) for rho in {1/2,1/4,1/8,1/16} all TRUE (johnson=0.293/0.500/0.646/0.750 vs half-edge=0.250/0.375/0.438/0.469), the general fact being 2sqrt(rho)<=1+rho <=> (1-sqrt(rho))^2>=0. PART 3 (PRIZE REGIME, proper dyadic mu_n, n=2^mu, q~n^beta, n<<sqrt q): at the interior probe delta=(johnson+cap)/2-1/log2 n, for n=32,64,256,1024,2^20,2^30 (rho=1/4, beta in [4,6]) the floor a=2t-n is ALWAYS < k, so C(a,k)=0 and interleavedList_card_le gives 0<=C(n,k): VACUOUS, certificate ceiling = infinity >> q in every prize row (also rho=1/8,1/16 at n=2^20). PART 4 (exponent gap, best case = the half-edge delta=(1-rho)/2 where a=k exactly, C(a,k)=1): certificate = C(n,k) ~ 2^{n H(rho)} = exponential in n vs budget q ~ 2^{beta log2 n} = polynomial in n. log2(cert)-log2(q) = -7.2 (n=16, artifact of tiny q), then 21.8 (n=64), 167.6 (n=256), 780.6 (n=1024), 850596.8 (n=2^20), 8.71e8 (n=2^30): the exponent gap diverges as nH(rho)-beta*log2(n). All three cited Lean lemmas (interleavedList_card_le, mcaBad_card_le_interleavedList, Lambda_interleaved_sandwich/deltaStar_collapse_backward) are real in-tree, sorry-free, axiom-clean, and read correctly by the connection.
honest_note: Sound structural insight, correctly grounded in all three cited in-tree files; it ties the radius-doubling necessity, the MDS-incidence non-vacuity threshold (1-rho)/2, and the sandwich collapse into one mechanism, giving quantitative meaning to the qualitative 'B4 circular, needs Lambda(C)<=O(1)' verdict. PROVEN component (an actual sharpening, slightly STRONGER than the connection states): the non-vacuity threshold (1-rho)/2 is not merely 'below the prize window' but is at-or-below the Johnson edge 1-sqrt(rho) itself (exact, = (1-sqrt rho)^2>=0), so the only unconditional handle is vacuous from the very bottom of the open window upward, not just in its interior; and at the best-case half-edge the certificate is exponential-in-n vs a polynomial-in-n budget (gap nH(rho)-beta log n), diverging in the prize regime. What is OPEN (and why this is PARTIAL not PROVEN): the connection does not advance past the wall -- by its own framing it is the quantitative form of a circularity. Any window-radius unconditional MCA bound via this collapse still REQUIRES a sub-C(n,k)/C(a,k) higher-order-MDS (GM-MDS) interior list bound for C^{=2} at the doubled radius, which is exactly the open prize core (W-subspace, welding to W-Johnson). NOT a closure; NOT a refutation (all cited lemmas are true). Probes are exact integer for the F3 enumeration / non-vacuity arithmetic and lgamma-based log2 for the large-n exponent gaps (no exact C(2^30,2^28) computed -- only its log, which is what the exponent claim needs). Suitable as a sharpening note for the B4 entry; recommend recording the half-edge<=Johnson-edge refinement.
